The girl on the left wears a black crop top with olive green trousers, and the girl on the right wears a camouflage patterned t-shirt with black pants. Behind them is a dark trophy shelf and a mirrored wall. They begin a choreographed routine, starting with rhythmic hand pulses above their heads. (2) The performers transition into more dynamic movements, executing high leg kicks and sharp arm thrusts while maintaining synchronized timing. At the top of the frame, a translucent horizontal overlay shows a five-member K-pop girl group performing the identical dance routine. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the focused facial expressions of the trio as they execute a series of hip circles and rapid hand transitions. (3) The routine continues with the performers moving into a wider stance, engaging in rhythmic bouncing and shoulder rolls. The central text overlay 'Meovv HANDS UP' remains static in the middle of the frame. The background shelf displays several distinct gold-colored trophies and decorative bottles, providing a structured depth to the room. The girls on either side follow the woman's lead with high precision and energy. (4) The trio enters the final phase of the choreography, which involves a series of dramatic arm extensions and stylized poses. They conclude with a final static pose, one arm raised vertically towards the ceiling, mimicking the dancers in the digital overlay above them. The camera remains completely static throughout the entire performance, focusing on the full bodies of all three dancers against the studio backdrop.
